notes.title: Patch 0.27d
notes.notes:
Changelog
Added different volume sliders for SFX and music

Added a pitch down effect to the music when a game ends

Added the ability to put caps in chat

Added a different text to only show your own messages

Added some new commands to the terminal

Changed the timer setting in presets so when it's the turn of your opponent, the zoom will go out instead of in

Changed camera sensitivity when you zoom in

Changed the controls texture so it shows the chat button too

Hey, little patch here, just fixing some stuff.

notes.title: Update 0.27
notes.notes:
Hi :3

Just a medium update after more than 2 months without any news, this patch adds a lot of bug fixes and changes the UI in-game to make it feel more interactive!
Changelog
Added post-processing to almost all UI and menus

The music now muffles when the fear meter rises, and the same with a grain effect

Added an exclusive player icon in the top left of the screen if the player has a S-rank

Changed the build type to Mono so mods can be made with ease

Changed \[Throw knife] card's chances to 1/3

Changed the gun model in the \[Gun]'s animation to look better

Changed the \[Gun]'s animation

Changed command line sounds

Changed the snake achievement so it can also be obtained with the pong minigame

Changed Duviz's icon in credits

Fixed a bug preventing the players from creating presets

Fixed steam thinking that the player is still in a game while they are in the menu

notes.title: Update 0.26
notes.notes:
Hi chat

Here you have an update for Tres, adding a gamemodes system.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121790/250dbd65449501d69e68b4ff8319bb37bf72c89f.png"]
Changelog 0.26:


 Added presets

 Presets are a way to create your own gamemode to customize how you play the game. For now, you can toggle the text chat, the timer (aka quick mode), extra cards added per round and cards players start with



 Added a sequence before starting the game


 Changed the store page


 Fixed a bug that caused the player unable to create a lobby after entering a tape


 I forgot to say that I added a new event in the last update... Well... Surprise I guess.

notes.title: Update 0.25
notes.notes:
Hi!!!!!1!

After a long time, here's an update that adds a lot of little stuff to make the game better!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121790/bf66c2288970cfc4bfe48dece80a38035d4d2031.png

Changelog 0.25:

 Added a clock in-game to reflect the time and interact with quick mode
 Added A LOT of new music (Thanks Wolicraft)
 Added two new cosmetics
 Added an info tab in the top left in-game
 Added the ability to wear multiple cosmetics at the same time
 Added the ability to draw by clicking the cards's holder
 Added the ability to zoom with the camera in-game
 Added a popup for the browse menu
 Added pop ups when you change ranks
 Added [spoiler]tapes[/spoiler] on the menu to replay [spoiler]secret scenes[/spoiler]
 Added descriptions to the buttons on the menu
 Added extra options in the extras menu (press the Konami code in-game)
 Changed the camera position in-game
 Changed once more the animation of buttons
 Changed fonts in some parts in the main menu
 Changed some texts
 Changed the positions of some decorations in-game
 Changed the draw animation
 Changed the default pronouns to now be They/Them (Sorry I forgot to change it since I added them)
 Compressed a lot of textures
 Extended the idle animation
 Reworked the corruption effect
 Fixed a lot of errors with the turns in-game
 A lot more that I don't remember...
